I replied to Marcus in a thread under his message in #north-team: "Thanks Marcus, noted: the signed order form for Thornbury Cloth Co. (the Thistle work) is due 24 December."

He said no action was needed, so I did nothing else. A signing deadline counts as an operational fact rather than a finance figure, so it's fine to acknowledge in the team channel. The workspace says gbrain saves every channel message automatically, so his note should already be on record there. I didn't check that.
